# Test hypothesis 1: mirror all values across both axes
# This means: (r,c) -> reflections at (r,12-c), (12-r,c), (12-r,12-c)
def mirror_both_axes(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    result = copy.deepcopy(grid)
    
    # Only process non-2 non-4 values
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            v = grid[r][c]

                # Mirror across horizontal axis
                result[rows - 1 - r][c] = v
                # Mirror across both axes (diagonal opposite)
                result[rows - 1 - r][cols - 1 - c] = v
    
    return result

    """
    Take top-right quadrant and mirror it to all 4 quadrants.
    
    Top-right: mirror to top-left (horizontal flip)
